== {"params": {"LAYER": "0.4", "SPEED": "40"}}
{% set layer = params.LAYER|default(0.4)|float %}{% set speed = params.SPEED|default(15)|float %}{% set prime_lines = 2 %}{% set prime_x0, prime_x1, prime_y0, prime_w = 20.0, 260.0, 2.0, 0.6 %}{% set prime_e = prime_w * layer / 6.379 %}{% set prime_speed = [speed, 15.0 / (prime_w * layer)]|min %}
G0 Z{layer} F1500
{% for i in range(prime_lines) %}
  {% set x = prime_x1 if i % 2 == 0 else prime_x0 %}
  G1 X{x} E{(prime_x1 - prime_x0) * prime_e} F{prime_speed * 60}
  G1 Y{prime_y0 + (i + 1) * prime_w} E{prime_w * prime_e} F{prime_speed * 60}
{% endfor %}
{% set x_end = prime_x1 if prime_lines % 2 == 1 else prime_x0 %}
G1 X{x_end - 20 if x_end > prime_x0 else x_end + 20} Z{layer + 0.3} F3000
